    Summary

    [edit]
    DescriptionFlag of the United States (1896–1908).svg US Flag with 45 stars. In use 4 July 1896–3 July 1908. Created by jacobolus using Adobe Illustrator, and released into the public domain. This flag was used during the Spanish-American War.
    Date 26 April 2006 (original upload date)
    Source No machine-readable source provided. Own work assumed (based on copyright claims).
    Author No machine-readable author provided. Jacobolus assumed (based on copyright claims).
